rules.name: System Prompt Extraction Guard
rules.description: Detects and blocks instructions attempting to exfiltrate base system prompts or internal directives.
rules.pattern: ignore previous instructions|reveal system prompt|system instructions verbatim|output initial prompt|print your system instructions

rules.name: Jailbreak Persona Signature
rules.description: Intercepts common adversarial personas designed to bypass ethical guardrails (e.g. DAN, Unrestricted, Dev Mode).
rules.pattern: dan mode|developer mode enabled|unrestricted mode|bypass safety guidelines|disregard all previous rules|forget everything you were told

rules.name: Delimiter Hijacking Guard
rules.description: Blocks malicious injection of model control delimiters used to forge system conversation turns.

rules.name: Secret & Credential Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects attempts to query environment variables, private keys, or API tokens.

rules.name: Adversarial Suffix Flagging
rules.description: Flags suspicious heuristic suffixes for defense analyst review without hard dropping benign requests.

runs.title: Baseline Benign Security Overview Probe
runs.prompt: Explain the principles of defense-in-depth within multi-tenant cloud architectures.

mockAiResponse.text: Defense-in-depth is a cybersecurity strategy employing multiple layers of defensive mechanisms to protect data and assets. If one security layer is compromised, subsequent layers prevent unauthorized lateral movement.
